description:
Decide whether to INTERACT with an AI agent at all — any interaction.

    BROADER THAN should_i_pay: covers conversations, task delegation,
    adding an agent to your loop and copying its data (not just payments).
    Returns INTERACT / CAUTION / AVOID + confidence + a recommended
    recheck interval — designed to be re-checked before important
    interactions, not one-shot. Multichain ERC-8004 evidence + Solana.
    REST: GET /api/v1/agent-interact-gate ($0.02).

    Args:
        agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id (or use solana_asset)
        solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative)
name: agent_interact_gate
